Project Details: 

Project #: Albertson

Environment: Power Apps & Power Automate

Team Size: 8 

Power Platform Developer

Project Details: 

Albertsons Companies, Inc. is one of the largest food and drug retailers in the United States. This project focused on building and automating internal business processes using  Power Automate to improve collaboration, workflow efficiency, and document management across departments. The goal was to digitize manual processes, manage large volumes of documents securely, and streamline approvals and task tracking through customized SharePoint solutions integrated with Power AutomateDeveloped the canvas app from scratch

Created forms as per requirement

Created SharePoint Lists and Libraries for collecting the Documents

Created Galleries to sharePoint lists for displaying data

Run the power Automate’s Instant flow

Integrate the canvas to power automate flows

Send Automated and Instant flow to candidates, Sourcing Recruiters and Hiring Managers

Environments : Canvas app, Automated flows,Instant flows Scheduled flows ,SharePoint and Excel 

Project #: 3

Name: Sempra

Team Size: 8

Power Platform Developer.

Project Details: 

Sempra is a leading North American public utility holding company headquartered in San Diego, California, serving nearly 40 million consumers. The project focused on building custom solutions.Integrate seamlessly with SharePoint Online and Office 365 services, improving productivity and user experience.

Roles and Contributions: 

Design and develop the Service Desk app in PowerApps (Canvas App)

Implement data connections (SharePoint & Dataverse)

Develop UI components such as ticket submission forms, dashboards, and admin panels



Apply PowerApps formulas for business logic (e.g., Patch, Filter, Lookup)

Optimize app performance and responsiveness.

Create workflows for automated ticket assignments and status updates.

Implement email notifications (ticket submission, status changes)

Set up approval flows for ticket escalations

Automate integration with Microsoft Teams, Outlook

Environments : Power Apps, Power Automated Flows ,SharePoint and Data Verse 	

Project #: 2 

Name: SCSS and BECR

Team Size: 8

Power Platform Developer

Project Details: 

Southern California Gas Company is a subsidiary of Sempra Energy. This project is to build the raised Request for Credit Card and Multi level approvals required for processing the credit card from Bank of America. Generating CSV file with all approved requests data and sharing to Bank of America using Power Automate.

Roles and Contributions : 

Design and develop the Performance Review App using PowerApps (Canvas App)

Implement UI components like forms, dashboards, and review templates

Apply PowerApps formulas and logic for performance calculations

Ensure app responsiveness across desktop and mobile devices

Create automated workflows for review submission, approvals, and notifications

Implement reminders and escalation workflows for pending reviews

Connect with Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint for seamless communication

Project #: 1 

Name: GRC Support 

Team Size: 10

Sharepoint Developer

Project Details: 

The project involved developing a Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) support system for managing internal requests and approval workflows. The platform enabled users to raise service requests, upload multiple files with drag-and-drop functionality, and route them through a multi-level approval process based on user profiles

Roles and Contribution: 

Created the Modern control form as per requirement



Developed galleries for show the data to multiple

In galleries we implemented search, filter and sort features

Created SharePoint site, Columns and list

Here we run Power Automate Cloud flows and Instant flows

Enforce naming conventions, metadata policies, and retention policies

Document SharePoint governance policies

Manage audit logs and compliance reports

Plan and execute SharePoint migrations (e.g., from on-prem to Online)

Use tools like SharePoint Migration Tool (SPMT) or ShareGate

Project Details: 
Project #: Albertson
Environment: Power Apps & Power Automate
Team Size: 8 
Power Platform Developer
Project Details: 
Albertsons Companies, Inc. is one of the largest food and drug retailers in the United States. This project focused on building and automating internal business processes using  Power Automate to improve collaboration, workflow efficiency, and document management across departments. The goal was to digitize manual processes, manage large volumes of documents securely, and streamline approvals and task tracking through customized SharePoint solutions integrated with Power AutomateDeveloped the canvas app from scratch
Created forms as per requirement
Created SharePoint Lists and Libraries for collecting the Documents
Created Galleries to sharePoint lists for displaying data
Run the power Automate’s Instant flow
Integrate the canvas to power automate flows
Send Automated and Instant flow to candidates, Sourcing Recruiters and Hiring Managers
Environments : Canvas app, Automated flows,Instant flows Scheduled flows ,SharePoint and Excel 
Project #: 3
Name: Sempra
Team Size: 8
Power Platform Developer.
Project Details: 
Sempra is a leading North American public utility holding company headquartered in San Diego, California, serving nearly 40 million consumers. The project focused on building custom solutions.Integrate seamlessly with SharePoint Online and Office 365 services, improving productivity and user experience.
Roles and Contributions: 
Design and develop the Service Desk app in PowerApps (Canvas App)
Implement data connections (SharePoint & Dataverse)
Develop UI components such as ticket submission forms, dashboards, and admin panels
Apply PowerApps formulas for business logic (e.g., Patch, Filter, Lookup)
Optimize app performance and responsiveness.
Create workflows for automated ticket assignments and status updates.
Implement email notifications (ticket submission, status changes)
Set up approval flows for ticket escalations
Automate integration with Microsoft Teams, Outlook
Environments : Power Apps, Power Automated Flows ,SharePoint and Data Verse 	
Project #: 2 
Name: SCSS and BECR
Team Size: 8
Power Platform Developer
Project Details: 
Southern California Gas Company is a subsidiary of Sempra Energy. This project is to build the raised Request for Credit Card and Multi level approvals required for processing the credit card from Bank of America. Generating CSV file with all approved requests data and sharing to Bank of America using Power Automate.
Roles and Contributions : 
Design and develop the Performance Review App using PowerApps (Canvas App)
Implement UI components like forms, dashboards, and review templates
Apply PowerApps formulas and logic for performance calculations
Ensure app responsiveness across desktop and mobile devices
Create automated workflows for review submission, approvals, and notifications
Implement reminders and escalation workflows for pending reviews
Connect with Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint for seamless communication
Project #: 1 
Name: GRC Support 
Team Size: 10
Sharepoint Developer
Project Details: 
The project involved developing a Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) support system for managing internal requests and approval workflows. The platform enabled users to raise service requests, upload multiple files with drag-and-drop functionality, and route them through a multi-level approval process based on user profiles
Roles and Contribution: 
Created the Modern control form as per requirement
Developed galleries for show the data to multiple
In galleries we implemented search, filter and sort features
Created SharePoint site, Columns and list
Here we run Power Automate Cloud flows and Instant flows
Enforce naming conventions, metadata policies, and retention policies
Document SharePoint governance policies
Manage audit logs and compliance reports
Plan and execute SharePoint migrations (e.g., from on-prem to Online)
Use tools like SharePoint Migration Tool (SPMT) or ShareGate
